mode: three-way-scan, limited to source verification and concise synthesis
common_why: These papers address different bottlenecks in making learned behavior scalable or reliable: communication and experience collection, adapting large frozen backbones, optimization, memory-based continuity, and measurement of training effects.
divergent_how: The mechanisms are not interchangeable: distributed systems schedule data and updates; PEFT and TokenGate add trainable modules; MuSGD changes parameter updates; memory-centric continual learning updates external state and management policies; the evaluation papers diagnose how training stages and supervision alter behavior.
